'''QM-35''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. He served as the guardian of the Tarisian Archive after the ruling members of the Taris governement froze themselves in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] during the [[Destruction of Taris|orbital bombardment]] of the planet by [[Darth Malak]]. He would remain there for over 300 years, guarding the Archive from [[rakghoul]]s and scavengers in the depths of [[Promised Land|Transport Station Five]], until the Archive was rediscovered by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individual.

==Biography==
QM-35 was created some time before the [[Jedi Civil War]] by the [[Taris/Legends|Tarisian]] government. When the ruling members of the government froze themselves in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] to escape the [[Destruction of Taris]], QM was charged with guarding the "Archive". QM-35 remained in the depths of [[Promised Land|Transport Station Five]] for 305 years until [[3643 BBY]], when a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individual braved the [[rakghoul]]s and found the Archive. QM told the individual about the archive, and informed them of the government's desire to thawed out when Taris was once again under Republic control. The individual would inform [[Wintag]]'s assistant [[Tiffan Nye]] about the Archive, who immediately began to gather a team to reach it.<ref name="The Archive" />

==Behind the scenes==
QM-35 was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Republic Taris mission "The Archive", where he guards the Archive deep in Transport Station Five. QM-35 states that it has been 111,325 days since the archive was last accessed, which is equivalent to 354.54 Taris years (each of which are 314 days) or 305 real-world years. However, the destruction of Taris occurred in [[3956 BBY]], approximately 313 years before the events of ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''.<ref name="The Archive" />

During the Empire storyline, QM-35 reappears in a heroic instance, where an Imperial individual assaulted the Archive, with the intent to destroy it. Along with [[Ember Squad]], QM-35 fought valiantly to defend the Archive, but was eventually defeated. Presumably, his remains were destroyed in the resulting explosion.<ref name="The Fathers of Taris" />
